steps.question_rule: Keep neighbour/domain, bond-component and orbital-basis inventories distinct. A pi component is not axial density; VSEPR is qualitative. Each action needs its actual local warrant and output, rather than a generic assertion that the source/model permits it.
steps.teaching_rule: Teach construction and its selected visual before summarizing the insight. Every source question needs an exact construction bridge; an exit uses a changed case with a concrete expected result, not a repeated worked input.

steps.question_rule: Close the valence-basis ledger: hybrid outputs plus residual functions equal the independent inputs, with no double use. Nuclear shape excludes lone-pair vertices. A geometry drawing does not uniquely measure an orbital basis.
steps.teaching_rule: Maintain a question-specific orbital allocation, conditions and independent changed check. Multiple questions may share a concept; a broad section label does not prove that each requested operation was constructed.

steps.question_rule: Contributors are bookkeeping alternatives, not switching structures. Count the occupied delocalised pi space, not only a drawn double bond. Orthogonal p directions constrain allene terminal planes; Pauli is not a blanket one-bond-per-orbital ban.
steps.teaching_rule: Preserve atom-local roles and every relevant electron/charge invariant through representations. Separate a supplied equivalence observation from the model label and from a unique physical orbital/charge claim.

steps.question_rule: Separate local counts, occupancy, adjacency, alignment and empirical evidence. A supplied overlap factor is not total energy. Preserve formal electron inventory under torsion; strength, barrier and unique basis require specified further evidence.
steps.teaching_rule: Use explicit model assumptions, a counterfactual or independently changed contribution, and an applicability stopping condition. Diagnosis compares a changed-case response with uncertain patterns; it does not assign mastery or a misconception from opening help.

claim: Actual rule checkpoints and production regeneration; not eight published blueprint releases or independent educational certification.
